## Professional & Research Experience

### Graduate Intern — Load Forecasting
**Dominion Energy** · Glen Allen, Virginia, USA  
May–August 2026

- Analyzed non-conforming and emerging electric load patterns to support utility forecasting and planning.
- Investigated data center load profiles and their implications for grid demand, forecasting uncertainty, and resource planning.
- Applied data analytics and visualization workflows to utility-scale load datasets.
- Collaborated with load forecasting engineers and planning stakeholders to translate analytical results into operational insights.

### Research Assistant
**Institute of Energy Conversion, University of Delaware**  
2022–Present

- Research renewable and resilient microgrid architectures for emerging data center loads.
- Apply machine learning and data analytics to bifacial photovoltaic system modeling and energy prediction.
- Model PV and battery energy storage systems for peak-load management and resilience.
- Contributed to research involving distributed energy resource integration and faster-than-real-time simulation.
- Mentor graduate students working on machine learning and renewable-energy data projects.

### Teaching Assistant
**Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering, University of Delaware**

- Support senior- and graduate-level instruction in renewable energy and photovoltaic systems.
- Lead laboratory activities, lectures, project guidance, and technical instruction.
- Develop instructional material and support student projects in renewable energy systems.

## Selected Research Areas

### Data Center Energy Systems
Grid impacts, load forecasting, emerging electric loads, microgrids, and energy infrastructure for large computing facilities.

### Renewable & Resilient Microgrids
Techno-economic analysis, PV+BESS systems, grid-connected and islanded architectures, resilience, and energy management.

### Photovoltaic Systems
Bifacial PV, irradiance characterization, performance monitoring, system modeling, and machine-learning-assisted power prediction.

### Power Systems & Energy Storage
Distributed energy resources, peak-load management, renewable integration, battery storage, and modern grid challenges.
